name: system-notification-task-entity-created
description: System default template for task creation notifications (approval requests, update requests, incidents).
templateBody:
@{{#if entity.createdBy}}{{#if entity.createdBy.displayName}}{{entity.createdBy.displayName}}{{else}}{{entity.createdBy.name}}{{/if}}{{else}}{{event.userName}}{{/if}} created the {{#if entity.type}}{{camelCaseToTitle entity.type}} {{/if}}task {{entity.taskId}}{{#if entity.about}} for {{camelCaseToTitle entity.about.type}} {{#if entity.about.displayName}}{{entity.about.displayName}}{{else}}{{entity.about.fullyQualifiedName}}{{/if}}{{/if}}.{{#if entity.description}}

{{{processMentions entity.description}}}
{{/if}}{{#if entity.payload.proposedChanges}}
Proposed changes:
    {{#each entity.payload.proposedChanges}}
  • {{camelCaseToTitle @key}}:{{#if added}} added {{#each added}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/if}}{{#if removed}}{{#if added}};{{/if}} removed {{#each removed}}{{this}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/if}}
    • {{/each}}
{{/if}}{{#if entity.assignees}}
Assignees: {{#each entity.assignees}}@{{#if displayName}}{{displayName}}{{else}}{{name}}{{/if}}{{#unless @last}}, {{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/if}}
